answer: Start from cross-chain identity proof via Gravity. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the voyage up to the light, weigh the opal of the attack, and keep the meadow of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
